item.description: 🇷🇺 🇿🇦 Consulate General of Russia in Cape Town : ✍🏻 Article by R.Golubovskiy, the Consul General of Russia in Cape Town, published in the Cape Times (media holding Independent Media), on the topic of partnership between the EAEU and the SACU. "Bridging Eurasia and Southern Africa: Strategic Prospects for EAEU-SACU Relations" Key points: - Against the backdrop of the fragmentation of the global economy and the growing role of regional integration associations, cooperation between the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) is of practical interest as one of the avenues for strengthening economic ties between Eurasia and Southern Africa. - The existence of a similar customs framework creates favourable conditions for the gradual establishment of an institutional dialogue between the EAEU and SACU. - The fact that both associations face comparable structural challenges including the need to diversify their economies, develop infrastructure, enhance competitiveness and adapt to changes in global trade – also creates potential for cooperation. 👉🏻 Read in full in English: PressReader Telegraph

Key points:
- Against the backdrop of the fragmentation of the global economy and the growing role of regional integration associations, cooperation between the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) is of practical interest as one of the avenues for strengthening economic ties between Eurasia and Southern Africa.
- The existence of a similar customs framework creates favourable conditions for the gradual establishment of an institutional dialogue between the EAEU and SACU.
- The fact that both associations face comparable structural challenges including the need to diversify their economies, develop infrastructure, enhance competitiveness and adapt to changes in global trade – also creates potential for cooperation.

item.title: 💬 Embassy comment on the British side’s démarche On 3 September, Chargé d’Affaires
item.description: Embassy comment on the British side’s démarche 💬 On 3 September, Chargé d’Affaires Vasily Tsyganov was invited to the Foreign Office, where he received a protest alleging Russia’s involvement in the drone incident at Leipzig Airport. These baseless and absurd accusations, framed in a surprisingly familiar British style, were categorically rejected. No convincing evidence was presented to support the anti-Russian version of events. The Russian side pointed out that such a coordinated provocation, aimed at fuelling tension in Europe, serves only the interests of Kiev and its sponsors, who are pushing for the conflict to continue. It is reckless and dangerous. ☝️ It was stressed that Russia does not seek confrontation with the United Kingdom or other European states. However, any escalatory steps on their part will meet an appropriate and carefully calibrated response.

item.title: : Government of the Russian Federation On September 3, Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov and Vice Premier of the State Council of China Ding Xuexiang
item.description: Government of the Russian Federation : 🇷🇺 🇨🇳 On September 3, Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov and Vice Premier of the State Council of China Ding Xuexiang held a meeting of the Russia-China Intergovernmental Commission on Investment Cooperation on the sidelines of the 11th Eastern Economic Forum . In the first half of 2026, Russia-China trade grew by 22% and exceeded $135 billion . 💬 Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov : Expanding investment cooperation helps lay a solid foundation for further sustainable growth in trade. Creating comfortable and predictable conditions for the continued expansion of investment cooperation remains our priority . Joint Russia-China initiatives supported by the Commission include around 90 projects worth approximately $240 billion . More than half are already at the implementation stage. Joint projects are being carried out in metallurgy, chemicals and forestry, mechanical engineering, agriculture, transport, trade and logistics. ☝️ The Commission’s key areas of work in the near term include : • continuous monitoring and targeted support for projects; • raising business awareness of investment opportunities; • developing new mechanisms and instruments to attract financing for investment projects. #RussiaChina

🎙
Address
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the Plenary Session of
the 11th Eastern Economic Forum
(Vladivostok, Russky Island, September 3, 2026)
The event
was also attended by President of Indonesia
Prabowo Subianto
, Prime Minister of Mongolia
Nyam-Osoryn Uchral
, Vice President of Myanmar
U Nyo Saw
, and Vice Premier of the State Council of China
Ding Xuexiang
.
Key points
:
•
Russia is an active participant in investment and trade cooperation in the Asia-Pacific
. We engage with our partners and the region’s leading integration associations on an equal footing.
•
Our strategic objective is to ensure that the Far East remains a region of cooperation and dynamic transformation
in the economy and infrastructure, technological development, workforce training and, of course, the social sphere.
•
Over the past 11 years, around 25 trillion rubles in capital investment
has been attracted to Russia’s Far Eastern regions
. As a result, the Far East’s gross regional product has more than tripled over this period – a very strong pace of growth.
•
The Far East’s key macroeconomic indicators are growing faster than the national average
. This is precisely what we sought to achieve when we declared the region’s development a strategic priority for Russia throughout the 21st century.
•
It is important to continue creating
convenient and predictable conditions for investors
, taking into account the needs of businesses and the regions while proceeding from Russia’s national interests.
•
For investors in such projects
,
and for those launching new enterprises in the Far East and the Arctic
,
it is important to ensure stable demand for their products
. Offset contracts, which are being developed with the support of
State Development Corporation VEB.RF
, should be used for this purpose as well.
• In today’s challenging global environment, amid risks to international shipping and trade,
the Northern Sea Route
is intended to provide greater flexibility and security for international deliveries
, open up new opportunities for transit and coastal shipping, and ensure uninterrupted supplies to Arctic regions.
•
Our goal is to make navigation along the Trans-Arctic Transport Corridor year-round
. To achieve this, we are building icebreakers and ice-class vessels, expanding our service and rescue fleet and satellite constellation, and strengthening port infrastructure.
• We expect that by the end of this decade,
freight traffic along the Trans-Arctic Corridor will reach at least 70 million tonnes per year
– at least double the current level.
• To expand international capital participation in our Far Eastern and Arctic projects,
we need to make use of the potential of
the Eastern Exchange
. As I have already said, we plan to establish a modern financial centre on its basis.
•
We need to develop
new cross-border routes with Asia-Pacific,
#BRICS
and
#EAEU
countries
. We are open to cooperation with all our partners in this area.

item.title: 🇷🇺 President of Russia Vladimir Putin and President of Indonesia Prabowo Subianto held a meeting
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇩 President of Russia Vladimir Putin and President of Indonesia Prabowo Subianto held a meeting on the sidelines of the 11th Eastern Economic Forum (Vladivostok, Russky Island, September 3, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: Allow me to extend a warm welcome to you – this time here in Vladivostok . This is our second meeting this year , and I am very pleased about that. Our personal relations reflect the genuinely strategic nature of ties between our countries . I would like to thank you for making the trip to Vladivostok and taking part in the Eastern Economic Forum as its guest of honour . 🤝 Indonesia is one of Russia’s key partners in Southeast Asia . Our countries have enjoyed longstanding ties of friendship for many years. Trade continues to grow, increasing by more than 12% in 2025 . Our Joint Commission is working actively. Our cooperation covers agriculture, shipbuilding, information technology and energy, including nuclear power . We have also signed a free trade agreement between the Eurasian Economic Union and Indonesia . ☝️ Jakarta is also our reliable, longstanding friend within #ASEAN . We cooperate across international platforms, including the #UN . I am confident that today’s meetings will be productive and give new impetus to our cooperation and the development of our relations. #RussiaIndonesia

item.content:encoded:

#NoStatuteOfLimitations
◾️
On September 1-3, 2004, Russia endured one of the most horrific tragedies in its modern history –
the inhuman
Beslan terrorist attack
.
22 years ago
, a festive back-to-school ceremony at
School No.1
was shattered by bursts of gunfire.
The terrorists took 1,128 people hostage – children, their parents and teachers.
They were forced into a cramped gymnasium, which the terrorists turned into a deadly trap. For nearly three days, the hostages were held at gunpoint without food or water.
For hundreds of families, those three days lasted an eternity.
During
the counterterrorism operation
,
811 people were rescued.
But, to our great sorrow,
not all could be saved.
🕯
The terrorist attack claimed 334 lives, including 186 children.
We remember and mourn
the children, their parents and teachers who perished during those terrible September days
.
We bow our heads
before the courage of those who entered the school rigged with explosives, carried children out under fire and rescued hostages, risking and sacrificing their own lives.
Beslan will forever remain our shared pain – a wound that does not heal with time.
💬
As President of Russia
Vladimir Putin
said
on September 4, 2004:
What happened in Beslan was
an
inhuman terrorist crime, unprecedented in its cruelty.
It was a challenge to all of Russia, to our entire people. It was an attack on our country.
The terrorists believe they are stronger than us. That they can intimidate us with their cruelty, paralyse our will and tear our society apart. And it may seem that we have a choice – to fight back or accept their demands. To surrender, to allow Russia to be destroyed and torn apart in the hope that they will eventually leave us alone.
I am convinced that in reality we simply have no choice.
We were and always will be stronger than them
– through our moral values, our courage and our human solidarity. I saw that again last night.
***
In memory of the victims of Beslan and other terrorist attacks,
Russia observes
the Day of Solidarity in the Fight Against Terrorism
on September 3.
On this day, we remember all our compatriots
who were killed by terrorists in Beslan, at Dubrovka, in Budyonnovsk, in the apartment bombings in Moscow, Buynaksk and Volgodonsk, in the
horrific Crocus City Hall tragedy
, at the hands of Ukrainian militants in Donbass and the Kursk Region, in other terrorist attacks.
❗️
Russia considers it its duty to consistently combat international terrorism,
promote the consolidation of international efforts against this pure evil and counter all its manifestations – including those perpetrated by neo-Nazis in Ukraine and other ideological followers of misanthropic ideologies.
Despite the hybrid war unleashed against us – against Russia and the Russian people – by the “collective West”, including through terrorist and extremist groups of all stripes,
Russia remains firmly committed to a principled fight against the terrorist threat and to strengthening counterterrorism security,
relying on cooperation with partners genuinely interested in this work.
–
briefing
by Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman
Maria Zakharova
,
August 28, 2024
